purpose: Causal hidden-frame reacquisition pilot, never use future bounce time, broadcast speed or official metric answers
fit: ordinary least squares constant velocity vs constant image acceleration over last five observed frames; blend prediction 50/50, fixed before scoring
candidate_selection: highest detector confidence multiplied by Gaussian distance likelihood, sigma=30px, hard radius=60px; same rule for all motion methods
reference_policy: manually verify genuine ball among raw detector boxes; independent pixel coordinates reviewed from image crops; no interpolated or predicted labels
limitations: Local image-plane acceleration is physics-inspired, not a calibrated 3D simulator. Camera perspective/zoom changes apparent acceleration. Correct-prefix seeding isolates gap recovery, not full automatic tracking. Existing detector training provenance may overlap example broadcast footage. No hyperparameter tuning on these four examples.
